title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M7 IS SHIPPED, MERGED AND CLEANED UP. Local main and origin/main are both e9306e6, tree ee06be3d; PR 36 squash-merged 2026-08-02 with every CI check green; the M7 branch (local and remote) and its worktree are deleted. The divergence probe layer is gone: needKeyedParents + divergedParents replace the three old mechanisms - two states, one batched read-only dispatch, every cannot-tell folded to diverged. M8 (CI-to-green loop) is the LAST MSP; M0 stays unauthorized.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN THE FRESH SESSION per user directive: dispatch a DEDICATED SMALL dynamic Workflow to plan, implement and ship M8 (CI-to-green loop, six escalation classes, spec section 4; depends on M1 and M5, both shipped; open decision (c) closed by 0087). Shape and fences are in 0213; fold in M7's two residuals per 0212. Re-derive EVERY anchor against e9306e6. The workspace is clean - NO pre-dispatch housekeeping remains.
open_risks: BASELINE AT e9306e6, where local main now sits: npm test is 1836 tests, 1835 pass, 1 fail, 0 skipped locally; the one failure is the environment-only protect-claude-config test. CI on PR 36 was fully green. Never quote a dirty-worktree figure as a CI number.

OPERATIVE GREEN TEST (0210): green means zero failures OTHER THAN .claude/hooks/tests/protect-claude-config.test.mjs, plus phase-parity and mirror-guard passing. Any OTHER failing test is a genuine red. NEVER restate this as 'the suite is green' - name the excluded test and its proof.

~/.claude SYMLINK TOPOLOGY IS BROKEN AND UNFIXED: ~/.claude/settings.json is a regular file, not a symlink out of the home tree. The guard's own error says it therefore discovers no repository base and STOPS PROTECTING THE CHECKOUT. That protection is inert locally.

STALE LEDGER COPIES (0209): decisions/ dirs under .claude/plugins/data/ are stale and produced a false BLOCKING finding claiming 0207 was fabricated. Only the _ledger git ref is authoritative. Treat any 'that decision does not exist' claim as a stale-copy read.

M7 RESIDUAL (a), NOW M8'S (0212): a batch entry binds to its target only by an agent-echoed parentId, nothing binding it to the endpoints diffed - a mis-keying route to a false not-diverged. Fix: echo checkedBuiltSha/checkedMergedSha per entry, fold unless both match. Both mirror halves.

M7 RESIDUAL (b), NOW M8'S (0212): both catches are bare, so a whole-batch dispatch failure is indistinguishable in the logs from N genuine divergences. Fix: pass log into the predicate ctx and restore the e2e logLines assertion. Both mirror halves.

DELETION PASSES OWE A REVIEWER LENS FOR TESTS THAT PIN SURVIVING BEHAVIOR. M7's only HIGH was a deleted test whose payload assertion still described live behavior; a fail-open mutation left all 1836 tests green. Spec section 11 line 330's own lesson recurring.

SQUASH-MERGE MAKES git branch -d REFUSE a fully shipped branch, since its commits are not ancestors of the squash. The proof that licenses -D is an EMPTY residual diff against origin/main, verified BEFORE the delete - the 0207 criterion, used again for M7.

PR BODIES FREEZE AT CREATION (0142): gh pr edit, api PATCH, GraphQL and the MCP update tool are gate-denied. Later facts go in a COMMENT. pr-create rejects angle brackets in --what and caps free text at 200 chars.
MERGE IS NOT GATED: gh api returned 404 'Branch not protected' on main and there are no required status checks, so a red CI does not block the merge button. A red must be surfaced in words.
STACKED PRs MERGE INTO THEIR DECLARED BASE (0207). Default to ONE PR (0208/0213); a genuine split ships the lower unit now and defers the upper - never a same-run stack.

FIVE PRE-EXISTING DIRTY PATHS stay untouched: modified .claude/settings.json and .zshrc; untracked engine-args.mjs.bak-*, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/, mitosis.js.bak-*. Stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. Four dirty worktrees remain by design (0195).

STANDING: plan fix rounds against INVARIANTS, never a finding list. Fence reviewers with 'cite the supplied receipts, re-run nothing' and leave exactly ONE agent permitted to execute checks - both fences held across the M7 run.

STILL UNOWNED, none M7's: dead reviewDecision payload at mitosis.js:1667/1671 and :3800; advance.toRestack/toOpen; .mitosis/ not gitignored plus two log lines claiming it is; the M3 termination residual; the frontierManifest dead-window argument.
ALSO UNOWNED: coverage-checker's bare invocation silently takes push mode and reports a false green; classifyRunOpenPRs is not extracted, so it cannot be unit-tested.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
SUPERSEDED 2026-08-02 by 0195: the leaked-worktree fence is lifted and DONE - 9 of 13 reaped, 4 dirty ones deliberately held. Still out of scope: the Step 0 reaper and the two parked stashes.
Re-opening M5. It is merged as 9ea75d6; the declared M3 termination residual (suite exit code not recovered) belongs to a later MSP, not to a re-run of M5.
